accounting_note: Source preparation is reported separately from choice and smoke inference; do not add duplicate cache copies or amortize preparation twice. Configured provider cost excludes local compute. No compiler dollar price is inferred by this archiver.

Local hardware, electricity, idle capacity and hosting overhead are excluded.
